goal: One simple ball with a clear outline and large areas to color, so the child can color it in the book.
colorPrompt: Make one drawing for a child's activity book. Draw it as clean black lines on a plain white background. The drawing is ONE simple BALL and nothing else: no child, no hand, no room, no background. The ball is one big round shape with a clear thick outline, and it fills most of the square picture. The ball is divided into a few LARGE areas by simple curved lines that run from the outline to the outline: three or four big areas, each one wide enough for a child to color with a crayon. The areas are big and simple: no small stripes, no thin lines, no small spots, and no tiny shapes. The ball has NO color: the drawing is black lines on white, so the child can color it. Every shape is a closed shape with one even line. No shading, no gray, no texture lines, no color, and no background shapes. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. The picture is for young children and is rated G.
linePrompt: Picture 1 is already a black-line drawing on white. Convert picture 1 to line art for a student book: thick, even black lines (about three times a normal outline), simple closed shapes that a 5-year-old can color, on pure white. No shading, no gray, no texture lines, no text. Keep every shape in the same place and the same size. The ball is one closed circle with a clear thick outline. The three or four big areas inside the ball are separate closed shapes that touch the outline of the ball. Keep the areas big and simple. Draw no child, no hand, and no background shapes. Every line ends on another line, with no loose ends. Do not draw any text, letters, or numbers.
